LESSON: CONTROLLING SOIL POLLUTION

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: AGRICULTURE
Strand: Conservation of Resources
Topic 1.1: Controlling Soil Pollution

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Controlling Soil Pollution
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: How can household practises cause soil pollution?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. explain the causes of soil pollution in gardening

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Controlling Soil Pollution

Teach
• Observe Controlling Soil Pollution in real life (school compound, home, farm).
• Use safe examples only.
• Name → explain → apply.

Worked example
• Fact 1 about Controlling Soil Pollution (in pupil words).
• Fact 2 with a Kenyan example.
• Safe action connected to Controlling Soil Pollution.

Try this
• Draw/label one diagram for Controlling Soil Pollution.
• Write 5 bullet facts about Controlling Soil Pollution.
• Say one safety rule.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• explain the causes of soil pollution in gardening

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. List 8 facts on Controlling Soil Pollution.
2. Teach a friend using only bullet points.

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Revision sheet for Controlling Soil Pollution: meaning, diagram, 5 practice questions.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How can household practises cause soil pollution?
